title: RL 串联电路的谐波分析
statement: 求电流 i 的各次谐波分量（有效值）和 i 的有效值 I。再求电路吸收的平均功率 P 和电源端的功率因数 λ = P/(VI)。

questions.explain: 直流时电感相当于短路：I_0 = V_0/R = 20/4 = 5 A。

questions.ask: 3 次谐波电流有效值 I_3 = ?
3 次谐波电流 İ_3 的初相 = ?
电路吸收的平均功率 P = ?
questions.explain: 只有 R 消耗功率：P = I²R = 26.71² × 4 = 2853 W。

questions.ask: 电源端的功率因数 λ = P/(VI) = ?

hints: 按叠加定理，直流、基波、3 次谐波三个分量分别单独作用，各算一次。
直流时电感短路；k 次谐波的感抗是 kωL，所以基波 ωL = 1 Ω，3 次谐波 3ωL = 3 Ω。
最后不能把相量相加：有效值 I = √(I_0² + I_1² + I_3²)，平均功率等于各次谐波功率之和（或 I²R）。

en.title: Harmonic analysis of a series RL circuit
statement: R = 4 Ω in series with L = 1 mH is connected to v_s = 20 + 100√2 cos(1000t) + 50√2 cos(3000t + 30°) V.
Find each harmonic component of the current i (rms) and the rms current I. Then find the average power P absorbed and the power factor λ = P/(VI) at the source.
hints: By superposition, let the DC term, the fundamental and the 3rd harmonic act one at a time.
At DC the inductor is a short; at harmonic k its reactance is kωL, so ωL = 1 Ω for the fundamental and 3ωL = 3 Ω for the 3rd harmonic.
Do not add the phasors at the end: the rms value is I = √(I_0² + I_1² + I_3²), and the average power is the sum of the harmonic powers (or I²R).
solution: **Check:** add the source's harmonic powers: P = V_{0}I_0 + V_{1}I_1 cos φ_1 + V_{3}I_3 cos φ_3 = 20 × 5 + 100 × 24.25 × cos 14.04° + 50 × 10 × cos 36.87° = 100 + 2353 + 400 = 2853 W — the same.

questions.explain: At DC the inductor is a short circuit: I_0 = V_0/R = 20/4 = 5 A.

questions.ask: rms value of the fundamental current, I_1 = ?
rms value of the 3rd-harmonic current, I_3 = ?
questions.explain: The reactance at the 3rd harmonic is three times larger: Z_3 = 4 + j3 Ω = 5∠36.87° Ω, I_3 = 50/5 = 10 A.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the 3rd-harmonic current İ_3 = ?
Average power absorbed by the circuit, P = ?
questions.explain: Only R dissipates power: P = I²R = 26.71² × 4 = 2853 W.

questions.ask: Power factor at the source, λ = P/(VI) = ?
questions.explain: V = √(20² + 100² + 50²) = 113.6 V, λ = 2853/(113.6 × 26.71) = 0.941. A non-sinusoidal circuit has no single impedance angle; the power factor can only be defined as P/(VI).
